questions.scenario: A stray dog or cat is sitting outside your house. What is your first reaction?

options.text: I try to build a small cozy shelter for it using cardboard.
I check if it has any injuries and try to apply basic medicine.
I Google what exact human food is safe for this specific animal.
I ask my neighbors to pool some money so we can buy a big bag of pet food.

questions.scenario: You are eating a slice of cheese pizza. What random thought crosses your mind?

options.text: I just eat it fast so I can go back to playing games or sports.
I make sure to save a small, safe piece of crust for my pet.
I look at the cheese and wonder how milk actually turns into this solid texture.
I look at the pizza box and judge if the company is making good profit.

questions.scenario: Your school takes you on a trip to a massive Zoo or Dairy Farm. What do you do?

options.text: I want to go inside the fences and physically feed or wash the animals.
I ask the guide what happens when an animal gets a fever or gets hurt.
I read every single information board about their species and diet.
I check out the gift shop and calculate how much money they make in a day.

questions.scenario: Every job has something 'gross' or messy. Which of these can you tolerate easily?

options.text: Cleaning up mud, dirt, and animal poop with a shovel.
Looking at blood, wounds, or giving an injection.
Looking through a microscope at weird bacteria for hours.
Dealing with angry customers who are shouting for a refund.

questions.scenario: You are playing a simulation game (like The Sims or Farmville). What is your strategy?

options.text: I spend all my time taming, breeding, and running around with the virtual animals.
I just focus on making sure all my characters have 100% health and happiness.
I upgrade all the machines and try to unlock the highest level items logically.
I sell everything in the global market to become the richest player in the game.

questions.scenario: You are at a grocery store with your parents buying milk. What do you usually do?

options.text: I carry the heaviest bags to the car without any problem.
I tell them to buy the brand that treats its cows ethically and kindly.
I read the back of the packet to check the Protein and Fat percentage.
I compare the prices of 4 different brands to see which is the best deal.

questions.scenario: You are scrolling through YouTube. Which video will you click on?

options.text: A daily vlog of a guy living on a farm, riding horses, and working hard.
A heartwarming video of an abandoned dog being rescued and cured.
A cool science animation explaining how genetics and biology work.
A Shark Tank pitch where someone made millions selling a new protein shake.

questions.scenario: In a school group project, what is the best role for you?

options.text: Running around, buying the chart papers, and doing the physical work.
Making sure nobody is stressed out and keeping the team happy.
Doing deep research on Google so our facts are 100% correct.
Standing up in front of the class to present it confidently to the teacher.

questions.scenario: You win a prize of ₹1 Lakh! What is your dream way to use it?

options.text: Buy a big piece of land on the outskirts of the city to keep a pet horse.
Donate a large part of it to an animal hospital or rescue shelter.
Buy a high-end laptop, a microscope, and a cool science kit.
Invest it in stocks or use it to start my own small online business.

questions.scenario: What is the best compliment someone can give you?

options.text: 'You are so strong, active, and hardworking.'
'You have a very kind, healing, and comforting presence.'
'You are so smart, logical, and notice every small detail.'
'You are a natural boss, very confident, and convincing.'

Dairy_Farm_Manager.title: Dairy Farm Manager / Livestock Expert
Dairy_Farm_Manager.primary_match_text: You are highly active and energetic! You prefer being outdoors and working physically with animals rather than sitting at a boring desk all day.
Dairy_Farm_Manager.day_in_the_life: Waking up early, managing a large herd of cows or horses, checking their diet, and ensuring the farm runs smoothly every single day.
Dairy_Farm_Manager.alternative_match_text: Since you have great physical stamina and love animals, managing the daily operations of a large dairy or stud farm is an excellent backup plan.
Dairy_Farm_Manager.roadmap: Take Science or Agriculture in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Sc in Animal Husbandry or Dairy Technology.

Veterinary_Healer.title: Veterinary Doctor / Animal Surgeon
Veterinary_Healer.primary_match_text: You are highly empathetic and caring. You cannot stand seeing someone in pain, and you don't get grossed out easily when it comes to helping others.
Veterinary_Healer.day_in_the_life: Examining sick animals, performing surgeries, prescribing medicines, and bringing joy to pet owners by saving their furry friends.
Veterinary_Healer.alternative_match_text: Because you have a naturally healing personality and a strong heart, becoming a vet or animal nurse is a beautiful alternative career for you.
Veterinary_Healer.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th. You will need to clear NEET or state exams to pursue BVSc & AH (Bachelor of Veterinary Science).

Animal_Scientist.title: Animal Nutritionist / Dairy Scientist
Animal_Scientist.primary_match_text: You are the brain behind the scenes! You are logical, detail-oriented, and love understanding the science of how things actually work.
Animal_Scientist.day_in_the_life: Working in a clean lab, testing the quality of milk, designing healthy diets for farm animals, and researching genetics to improve breeds.
Animal_Scientist.alternative_match_text: If you ever decide you want to work more with your brain in a lab rather than in the mud, researching animal science and nutrition is a great fit.
Animal_Scientist.roadmap: Take Science (PCM/PCB) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Sc in Dairy Science, Biotechnology, or Animal Nutrition.

Dairy_Brand_Owner.title: Dairy Brand Owner / Agribusiness Entrepreneur
Dairy_Brand_Owner.primary_match_text: You have a pure street-smart business mind. You know how to talk to people, manage money, and scale up a product to make a profit.
Dairy_Brand_Owner.day_in_the_life: Managing a brand like Amul or a boutique cheese company, running marketing campaigns, and negotiating deals with big supermarkets.
Dairy_Brand_Owner.alternative_match_text: If you want to focus on the money and leadership side of the animal industry, building a premium dairy or pet-food brand is a highly profitable path.
Dairy_Brand_Owner.roadmap: Take Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA, B.Com, or an MBA in Agribusiness Management.
